name: Alan Becker Stickmen
description: Orange, Red, Blue, Green and Yellow, the stick figures of Alan Becker's animations, join you in Minecraft: they follow you, do flips and dances, fight monsters and mine ores for you. Orange has a hollow head, a command staff he uses when commands are enabled, and writes messages on your screen. Draw them with the Animator's Pencil (stick + coal + paper). Unofficial fan project.
